newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks firm in London after record surge.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks firm in London after record surge.

text.p: Hong Kong shares were generally firmer in London, bolstered by another surge in London and on Wall Street, dealers said on Friday.
By 1436 GMT, the Hang Seng London Reference index was up 208.93 points to 14,139.73.
Shares in HSBC Holdings and Hong Kong Telecom led the advance and were by far the most actively traded shares, dealers said.
HSBC shares added HK$0.07 in London from their Hong Kong closing level amid a broad-based rally in the financial sector.
Shares in Hong Kong Telecom advanced about HK$0.30 from their Hong Kong close after news of Chinese investment in the telecommunications concern.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng jumped to a record close, climbing 190.5 points to 13,930.80.
